dedupe_keys.name: pycirk circular economy input output model

description: pycirk is a Python model for changing production, material use and trade assumptions in environmentally extended input-output tables. Its authors use EXIOBASE supply and use tables to study recycling, product life extension, efficiency and other circular-economy interventions. Users specify a region and changes to transaction, final-demand, resource or emission matrices in a spreadsheet or command-line workflow; outputs are revised scenario matrices and environmental results. The README documents a 2011 base for EXIOBASE 3.3 across 49 regions, with an EU versus rest-of-world aggregation option; it does not imply current-year observations. Source is freely available under GPL-3.0, but running the documented workflow also requires obtaining the separate EXIOBASE database. A limitation is that input-output coefficients and assumed intervention changes simplify firm-level supply-chain behaviour. It can support industrial resource-flow and infrastructure-material scenario comparisons. The catalogue's data-exiobase describes the underlying data family, while this record covers the scenario code. No database was downloaded or model run.
